t: You're looking at Square the Block, an art installation or sculpture by Richard Wilson. Wilson is an English sculptor, installation artist and musician, born in 1953, and he made this piece. That is about all I can say with confidence, so rather than guess at how it was built or what it means, take a moment to look at it yourself. Walk around it if you can, and notice how it sits against the buildings and the street around it. Installation art like this is often meant to change how you see its surroundings.
